title: FizzBuzz Variant
prompt: Write a function that takes an integer n and returns a label string using these custom rules (in this exact order of concatenation): if n is divisible by 3, include 'Fizz'; if divisible by 5, include 'Buzz'; if divisible by 7, include 'Bang'. Concatenate all that apply, in that order (e.g. n=105 -> 'FizzBuzzBang'). If none apply, return str(n).
